notes.title: MOURNIGHT v0.1.0 Update – Major Improvements!
notes.content:
A new update has arrived, bringing big improvements and fixes to MOURNIGHT!


New Main Menu – Completely redesigned for a better experience.

Crash Fixes – The game no longer crashes when entering.

Lobby System – Create lobbies, invite friends easily, and join directly with invites. You can now set a password for your lobby.

Key & Door Improvements – Doors are now numbered, and keys match them for easier navigation.

New Language Support – Added Turkish, Russian, and Simplified Chinese!

More updates coming soon—stay tuned and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update v0.0.2 - Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Dear players,
The v0.0.2 update is now live! We've fixed some bugs and made general improvements to the game. Here are the changes in this update:


 The item description screen no longer causes the game to freeze.
Previously, when an item was picked up, the description screen would not close, causing the game to freeze. This screen has been temporarily removed, resolving the issue.

 Several map-related bugs have been fixed.
We've addressed a few issues with the map.

 A few minor bugs have been fixed.
Various small fixes have been made to improve the overall stability of the game.

If you've encountered these issues in previous versions, give it another try! Don't forget to share your feedback and suggestions with us.

Thank you and enjoy the game!
